name: Bealiah
title: One of David's mighty warriors from Benjamin
summary: Bealiah was one of the Benjamite warriors who joined David while he was fleeing from King Saul in Ziklag. He was known as a skilled warrior who could use both his right and left hand to sling stones and shoot arrows with a bow. He belonged to the group of Saul's relatives who left Saul to support David.

keyEvents.title: Joins David in Ziklag
keyEvents.description: Bealiah was among the Benjaminite warriors who came to David at Ziklag while he was still hiding from Saul. They left their kinsman Saul to support David.

keyEvents.title: Skilled warrior with both hands
keyEvents.description: Bealiah and his fellow soldiers were known for their ability to use both right and left hands to sling stones and shoot arrows with a bow, making them highly valuable warriors.

keyEvents.title: Benjaminites leave Saul
keyEvents.description: It was remarkable that these warriors belonged to the tribe of Benjamin, the same tribe as Saul, yet chose to leave him to follow David, the anointed future king.

keyEvents.title: Part of David's growing army
keyEvents.description: Bealiah helped strengthen David's military capacity during a critical period when David was gathering support from various tribes in Israel before becoming king over all the people.
